name: Dranik Sewers: Purifying Plant
summary: The corrupted Dragorn water purification facility now overrun by Muramite forces and Discord energy.
description: The Purifying Plant was once the heart of Dragorn water engineering, filtering and distributing clean water throughout Dranik. After the Muramite invasion, the facility was seized and repurposed for experimentation. Discord energy seeped into the machinery, corrupting the filtration chambers and destabilizing the water flow. Toxic runoff, arcane pressure, and malfunctioning machinery make the plant extremely hazardous. Muramite engineers and beast‑handlers patrol the area, while Discord anomalies erupt from ruptured pipes.
